items.title: Executable Is a SQLite Database
items.title_zh: 把可执行文件变成SQLite数据库
items.title_en: SQLite as an Executable Format: Self-Describing and Queryable
items.summary: Proposes and explores using SQLite as the container/format for an executable, leveraging its virtual tables and dynamic linking to create a self-describing, modifiable, and queryable binary format.

items.title: Xiaomi: New CPU matches Apple cores single threaded, much faster multithreaded
items.title_zh: 小米XRing O3处理器据称单核追平苹果，多核领先
items.title_en: Xiaomi's XRing O3 CPU reportedly matches Apple in single-core, leads in multi-core
items.summary: Xiaomi's new CPU reportedly matches Apple's single-core performance and exceeds it in multithreaded benchmarks, drawing attention to its competitive impact despite open questions about power consumption.

items.title: MS Paint and Photos inivisibly watermark even locally generated output with GUID
items.title_zh: MS Paint 与照片应用在 AI 编辑图片中嵌入隐形 GUID 水印
items.title_en: MS Paint and Photos Embed Invisible GUID Watermarks into AI-Edited Images
items.summary: MS Paint and Photos silently embed invisible GUID watermarks into locally AI-edited images, enabling provenance tracing and raising privacy concerns.

items.title: The entire city of San Francisco as a video game
items.title_zh: 旧金山全城变身可玩网页游戏
items.title_en: San Francisco Cityscape Turns into a Playable Web Game
items.summary: A web-based project that renders all of San Francisco as a playable video game using real GIS data, drawing significant community engagement and discussion.

items.title: SeL4 security proofs now complete on AArch64
items.title_zh: seL4在AArch64上的安全证明已完成
items.title_en: seL4 Security Proofs Completed for AArch64
items.summary: seL4's complete security proofs on AArch64 mark a significant step forward in formally verified microkernels.

items.title: Coding expertise is going to collapse from AI reliance
items.title_zh: 依赖AI编程将导致编码专业知识崩塌
items.title_en: AI Reliance Will Collapse Coding Expertise, Article Warns
items.summary: Argues that excessive reliance on AI coding tools will erode deep coding expertise and create unsustainable engineering practices.

items.title: AgentX - InferenceXv3: Does CUDA Moat Hold up in Agentic Inferencing?
items.title_zh: AgentX：CUDA 护城河能否经受 Agentic 推理考验？
items.title_en: AgentX: Does CUDA Moat Survive Agentic Inference?
items.summary: This analysis examines whether NVIDIA's CUDA ecosystem retains its competitive advantage in agentic inference, backed by an open-sourced dataset and performance benchmarks across leading hardware.

items.title: Delay-corrected Bellman operator + causal attribution for constrained RL contraction proof under unknown stochastic delay [R]
items.title_zh: CCPL：延迟校正Bellman算子与因果归因用于受限强化学习
items.title_en: CCPL: Delay-Corrected Bellman Operator and Causal Attribution for Constrained RL
items.summary: Introduces CCPL, a constrained RL approach with a delay-corrected Bellman operator and causal attribution network for handling delayed stochastic consequences.

items.title: Hugging Face 探索出售，估值或达 130 亿美元
items.title_zh: Hugging Face 探索出售，估值或超130亿美元
items.title_en: Hugging Face Explores Sale at $13B+ Valuation
items.summary: Hugging Face is exploring a potential sale at a valuation of $13 billion or more, according to Bloomberg.
